verdict.lessonRecorded: An earlier turn reasoned "changed-tree totals (171/169) are below the clean baseline (176), therefore zero new failures". That inference is valid for TOTALS but unsound per FILE: one file improving can mask another regressing. File-by-file comparison caught what the total hid.
verdict.baselineNotRewritten: Still refused --save-baseline; rewriting it would have buried this regression permanently.
